en.answer:
Yes, you can.

(TL note: In the OCG, once per turn restrictions such as <<16650>>'s refer to the effects by their index number. <<16650>> has text along the lines of "You can only use the ②nd effect of <<16650>> once per turn". The question makes sense in that context.)
en.question: My <<16650>> has gained the effects of <<14196>>. Can I activate its own ②nd effect (the ②nd effect described on "<<16650>>") and the gained ②nd effect (the ②nd effect described on "<<14196>>") in the same turn?
en.title: If <<16650>> gains the effects of <<14196>>, can it activate both its own ②nd effect and <<16650>>'s ②nd effect?

ja.answer: 同一ターン中にそれぞれ発動できます。
ja.question: 「<<14196>>」の効果を得た「<<16650>>」は、得た『②』の効果（「<<14196>>」に記載された『②』の効果）と、自身が元々持っている『②』の効果（「<<16650>>」に記載された『②』の効果）を、同一ターン中にそれぞれ発動できますか？
ja.title: 「<<14196>>」の効果を得た「<<16650>>」は、得た『②』の効果と自身の『②』の効果をそれぞれ発動できますか？
